title: Neutral zone
description: The ground generated between the two boards of a battle (W1-8). Zone-local coordinates: x along the front edge, y = 0 the row touching side 0's front edge, y = depth - 1 the row touching side 1's front edge. features is sorted by (y, x) and lists every blocked cell; the first and last rows and the first and last columns never hold a feature, and all open cells are 4-connected.

pointsOfInterest.description: Always empty for now; reserved so the format does not change when points of interest are added (TA-41a).
